statement: Let visitors discover public software projects and let local developers manage repositories, issues, merge requests, pipelines, members, and project settings without contacting GitLab or causing production effects.

actors.description: Anonymous visitor browsing public marketing and project pages.
Authenticated local account that creates and changes owned projects.
Project member allowed to review changes and manage access.

simulations: Registration and password recovery use the local-only WebsiteBench mail outbox.
Pipeline execution and retry are deterministic local simulations with visible logs.
out_of_scope: Real email delivery, external invitations, webhooks, OAuth, SSO, and identity-provider calls
Live Git transport, package registries, runners, deployments, and production CI execution
Billing, subscriptions, checkout, payment credentials, and payments
Source-authenticated visual fidelity for pages blocked by Cloudflare verification
Any runtime request to about.gitlab.com, gitlab.com, docs.gitlab.com, or third-party services
